items.headline: Iran strikes at Bahrain again as peace talks stall
items.summary: Iran launched a drone attack on Bahrain on Sunday, its second in three days, ending a roughly two-month lull.

items.headline: Iran reports three tankers struck by mines near Hormuz
items.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says tankers caught fire after hitting mines. Reuters could not verify the reports.

items.headline: Italy fines Meta €805m over Android data access
items.summary: Italy's data protection authority says Meta accessed photos, videos and metadata on Android phones without informed consent.

items.headline: Government looks for a high-profile chair for an electoral reform commission
items.summary: Ministers want a well-known figure to lead a commission on how the UK votes. Nothing is decided yet.

items.headline: IMD: Bay of Bengal low to become a cyclonic storm by Monday evening
items.summary: A severe cyclonic storm is expected around 18 Nov, possibly near the Andhra Pradesh–Odisha coast.
